personAccess.title: Who accompanies you
personAccess.text: This is who has access to which part of your answers. You decide per area, and you can take any access back at any time.
personAccess.neverShared: Never included are your stories from the conversations — neither from the capability nor from the direction interview. At most, results you confirmed are shared.

scopeHints.base: Name, short description, focus areas, location
scopeHints.alignment_report: The six dimensions from the questionnaire
scopeHints.capability: Which areas you entered — without depth
scopeHints.capability_depth: Plus how often you applied it and what you want to own
scopeHints.strengths: The sentences about how you work, with your assessment

personAccess.claimFailedText: It may have expired, been claimed already, or been addressed to a different email than the one you are signed in with. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
personAccess.invite_claimed: The request is here. Below you decide what becomes visible.

holder.org: The organisation holds this access — it stays if the person who asked leaves.
holder.person: This person holds the access — nobody else.

teamReview.title: Being looked at together
teamReview.text: Sometimes someone wants to look not just at you, but at you alongside others — how you stand in relation to each other. That is a statement about all of you, so everyone is asked separately, and it only comes about once everyone has agreed.
teamReview.whatItMeans: What would be visible is how your entries look side by side — who wants to own which areas and where you overlap. Your questionnaire answers stay with you.
teamReview.revokeMeaning: You can withdraw at any time, including after agreeing. It ends the joint evaluation for everyone — it consists precisely of your entries coming together. You are not taking away anything anyone is entitled to.
